title: Federal Lobbying Disclosure Filings (LD-2)
description: Lobbying Disclosure Act filings from the Senate/House LDA database: registrant (lobbying firm), client, quarter, income or expenses, issue areas, specific issues lobbied, government entities contacted and lobbyists named. Filter by client, registrant, year or issue.
useCases: Public-affairs teams tracking who lobbies on their issue
Journalists following money into an agency
Sales teams finding companies with active policy spend
limits: Lobbyist names are the registered lobbyists listed on the public filing.
